steps.title: Open Affiliates
steps.body: Find the partner and review identity, status, agreement, rate, payment details, and referral history.

steps.title: Verify attribution
steps.body: Confirm the referred account, referral link or evidence, date, source, and any attribution window.

steps.title: Confirm qualification
steps.body: Check the customer payment, refund period, excluded products, taxes, discounts, and agreement conditions.

steps.title: Calculate commission
steps.body: Compare the system amount with the contract rate and eligible collected revenue.

steps.title: Approve and pay
steps.body: Use required approval, record payment date and reference, and never mark paid before funds are sent.

steps.title: Retain evidence
steps.body: Keep the agreement, attribution, customer payment, calculation, approval, and payout confirmation.
